data.name: Brahma
data.gender_notes: Brahma is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The creator; the absolute; sacred knowledge
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root bṛh, 'to grow, expand' — brahman, 'the absolute'. Its root is Sanskrit bṛh (बृह्). Brahma, the creator in the Hindu trimurti. Brahma is a Sanskrit name meaning “The creator; the absolute; sacred knowledge”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Brahma expresses “The creator; the absolute; sacred knowledge”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root bṛh, 'to grow, expand' — brahman, 'the absolute'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brahma total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

faq.q: From which word is Brahma derived?
faq.a: From the Sanskrit root bṛh, 'to grow, expand' — brahman, 'the absolute'.

faq.q: Is Brahma mentioned in scripture or history?
faq.a: Brahma, the creator in the Hindu trimurti.

faq.q: What is the historical or scriptural reference for Brahma?
faq.a: Brahma, the creator in the Hindu trimurti.

faq.q: What is the lucky number for Brahma?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Brahma is 7 (ruling planet Ketu). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.q: Which day is associated with Brahma?
faq.a: Tuesday is the traditional association for Brahma. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which gemstone is associated with Brahma?
faq.a: Cat's Eye is the traditional association for Brahma. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which colours are associated with Brahma?
faq.a: Grey, Smoke are the traditional associations for Brahma. These are interpretive.

faq.q: What is the numerology of Brahma?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brahma total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

faq.q: How reliable is the meaning given for Brahma?
faq.a: The meaning of Brahma carries confidence HIGH in this record. It is established by classical lexicography or scripture.

faq.q: Does Brahma have a religious meaning?
faq.a: Brahma is recorded as a hindu name meaning “The creator; the absolute; sacred knowledge”.

faq.q: What is the English meaning of Brahma?
faq.a: In English, Brahma is rendered as “The creator; the absolute; sacred knowledge”.

faq.q: Is Brahma suitable for a baby?
faq.a: Brahma is used as a male given name; suitability is a personal choice.
